method.geometry: Every evaluated source triangle, no decimation or display GLB used
method.broadPhase: All object pairs at rest, and each active group against every source object at each pose; AABB pruning only
method.containmentTest: Three non-axis oriented exit-minus-entry ray counts agree; exact float64 triangle-plane/edge tests exclude surface points; complete float64 grid/ray fallback resolves disagreeing BVH votes; no nearest-normal-only conclusion
method.componentCoverage: Blender native Mesh Island field provides a representative for every connected source component, additional nearby vertices and intersecting-face centroids sampled bidirectionally
method.motion: Caps, ABXY labels and remaining upper spring seats move -Z; springs compress around fixed lower plane; switch actuators move max(0,stroke-pretravel) in -Z
limitations: Discrete poses are not continuous collision detection.
Bounded containment/depth witnesses are not complete maximum-penetration or manufacturing-clearance measurements.
Open or inconsistent topology is never treated as a reliable containment target.
Unclassified contact is unknown, never a pass; exact pair plus bounded local design interface is required.
Different-key moving members additionally use independent pairwise stroke Cartesian products; interpolation between listed samples is not certified.

Spring geometry uses the application's affine axial display compression. Wire cross-section preservation, spring solid length and force require the separate spring specification; this source-envelope audit is not a spring material simulation.
Every harness object also receives a mandatory exact source self-intersection check. Self-intersection of other objects and manufacturing defects remain outside this inter-object audit scope.
Material stiffness, friction, tolerance distribution and electrical connectivity are not established by this mesh audit.
